profile.name: Alten S.A.
profile.summary: Alten S.A. operates as an engineering and technology consultancy company in France, North America, Germany, Scandinavia, Benelux, Iberian, Italy, the United Kingdom, the Asia-Pacific, Switzerland, Eastern Europe, and internationally. It undertakes projects for the technical, research and development, and information systems divisions of industrial, telecoms, and service clients. The company also provides engineering services, such as mechanic and materials, data management, systems engineering and PDM, project management office, quality assurance, manufacturing, environment, health and safety, electronics; embedded software; and construction infrastructure services. In addition, it provides IT services comprising AMOA and business analyst; cybersecurity; artificial intelligence; application software; data management; green IT; software testing and QA; and cloud and infrastructure services. The company serves customers in aeronautics, space, defense and naval, security, automotive, rail and mobility, energy and environment, life sciences and health, banking, industrial equipment and electronics, banking, finance and insurance, telecoms, retail, services, media, and public sectors and government services. Alten S.A. was incorporated in 1988 and is headquartered in Boulogne-Billancourt, France.
profile.summary_fr: Alten S.A. est une société de conseil en ingénierie et technologie en France, en Amérique du Nord, en Allemagne, en Scandinavie, au Benelux, en ibérique, en Italie, au Royaume-Uni, en Asie-Pacifique, en Suisse, en Europe de l'Est et à l'international. Il entreprend des projets pour les divisions techniques, de recherche et développement et de systèmes d'information des clients industriels, télécoms et de services. La société fournit également des services d'ingénierie, tels que la mécanique et les matériaux, la gestion des données, l'ingénierie des systèmes et PDM, le bureau de gestion de projet, l'assurance qualité, la fabrication, l'environnement, la santé et la sécurité, l'électronique, les logiciels embarqués et les services d'infrastructure de construction.
